verification.verification_notes: Full scan text inspected this session; locators confirmed without quoting: Translator's Introduction p. xvi (the tradition's apparatus of piety is what Kabir denounced); Poem XXI pp. 28-29 (priestly garb and sworn devotion masking predation); Poems LXV-LXVII pp. 68-71 (idol-worship, ceremonial dress, and ritual bathing mocked); Poem LXIX pp. 72-73 (wonder-working friar scene with Hindu/Muslim irony). Open Library OL316213W corroborates title, translator, and 1915 first publication. All content described, never reproduced.
